name: fantawriter
description: Inkborne / 墨生万象（原名幻想作家）— InkOS-kernel Windows desktop writing studio
author: Inkborne

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @actalk/inkos-core test && pnpm --filter @actalk/inkos-studio test && pnpm --filter @actalk/inkos test && pnpm --filter @fantawriter/desktop test
scripts.typecheck:tests: pnpm --filter @actalk/inkos-core build && pnpm --filter @actalk/inkos-core typecheck:tests && pnpm --filter @actalk/inkos-studio typecheck:tests
scripts.test:build: pnpm --filter @actalk/inkos-studio test:build && pnpm --filter @actalk/inkos-studio exec vitest run src/api/static-assets.test.ts
scripts.test:authoring-ui: pnpm --filter @actalk/inkos-studio exec vitest run src/__tests__/weave-write-handoff.test.ts src/lib/write-directory.test.ts src/lib/toast.test.ts src/lib/authoring-nav.test.ts src/components/ask-session-actions.test.ts src/components/ask-canon-state.test.ts src/lib/weave-editor-state.test.ts src/lib/ground-drafts.test.ts src/store/chat/slices/message/action.test.ts src/store/chat/slices/message/runtime.test.ts src/store/chat/slices/message/stream-events.test.ts
scripts.test:llm-compat: pnpm --filter @actalk/inkos-core exec vitest run src/__tests__/claude-sampling.test.ts src/__tests__/foundation-reviewer-claude-sampling.test.ts src/__tests__/provider.test.ts src/__tests__/temperature-constraints.test.ts
